title: The World That Is Continually Created

represented_relations.description: God freely creates, not by transferring pre-existing or divine material
Water, sunlight, growth and human action operate within creation
All creatures remain dependent in being on the Creator at each moment
The created world develops while preserving distinct created identities

not_claimed: God is a physical field or energy beam
God is an additional creature in the scene
Creation is repeated physical manufacture at each moment
The created entities represent the three persons of the Trinity
Visual depiction demonstrates the truth of Catholic doctrine
Real comprehension has been empirically confirmed
composition: one continuous living landscape with camera progression
known_visual_misreadings: revelation of contour read as arrival of divine presence
sun radiation conflated with metaphysical sustaining
